content: Vivaan asked Neha to clarify what is covered for trip cancellations due to medical emergencies, how to file a claim and what documents are needed, and whether his previous policy has expired. Neha confirmed 100% coverage for non‑pre‑existing medical conditions, outlined the claim filing requirements (doctor’s report, cancellation proof, claim form), said she will email the form, and indicated the old policy is now expired.

action_items: Neha to email the claim form to Vivaan
Vivaan to provide medical report, proof of cancellation, and completed claim form when filing a claim
